content:
I am pleased to share that I have received a Certificate of Participation for attending the insightful webinar:
"Can AI Decide Disputes Without Killing Due Process?"

The session provided valuable perspectives on the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Law, exploring the opportunities and challenges AI presents in the justice system while emphasizing the importance of due process.

It was an honor to learn from 𝙋𝙧𝙤𝙛. 𝘼𝙣𝙟𝙖𝙡𝙞 𝘾𝙝𝙖𝙬𝙡𝙖, 𝘼𝙨𝙨𝙤𝙘𝙞𝙖𝙩𝙚 𝙋𝙧𝙤𝙛𝙚𝙨𝙨𝙤𝙧 & 𝘼𝙨𝙨𝙤𝙘𝙞𝙖𝙩𝙚 𝘿𝙚𝙖𝙣, 𝙅𝙞𝙣𝙙𝙖𝙡 𝙂𝙡𝙤𝙗𝙖𝙡 𝙇𝙖𝙬 𝙎𝙘𝙝𝙤𝙤𝙡 (𝙅𝙂𝙇𝙎), 𝙊.𝙋. 𝙅𝙞𝙣𝙙𝙖𝙡 𝙂𝙡𝙤𝙗𝙖𝙡 𝙐𝙣𝙞𝙫𝙚𝙧𝙨𝙞𝙩𝙮, whose expertise made the discussion highly engaging and thought-provoking.

A sincere thanks to Law Jurist for organizing this informative webinar and creating such a valuable learning platform.
I look forward to continuing my journey of learning and exploring emerging developments in AI, Law, and Legal Technology.
